svg.title: Project 6: festival eye
svg.text: Top: trace the gray design on both eyes. Bottom: paint it yourself from the gray start dots. Eye-safe products only inside the red dotted line.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
Liner, crease, brow-bone color and dots: eye-safe products. Chevrons, dot trails and gems: outside the eye area only.
